name: Kurakawa Yuuko
source:
She likes to drink and enjoys gambling on her days off within her allowance.

After graduating from a women's junior college, she left home and lives alone in an apartment in front of the station.

She is usually a cheerful and unpretentious older sister, but sometimes she bursts into tears when she remembers the good old days.

[From [url=http://www.studio-74.net/works/works-patisserie.html]official site[/url]]
